speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are at my table, and there is a king on at the Theatre. I can tell the difference. You are here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard the Third, at two. I am not in it. The bill was read to me on Saturday. I did not ask to be written back in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the board is the afternoon. Threepence, the same as any meal you take in this house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence is the rate. I am not turning a dinner into a play I am missing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Miss it, and eat. I will not have you inventing a part between the bread and the cup.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No part. The sheet from this morning is upstairs. It is not this king. I am staying in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will leave the casement on the hook. The morning's fly can have the yard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The fly is not a guest. You are. Sit the hour, and do not tell me a plot you are not in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sitting. The king can do without me. He was told as much.
